ai_drafts.note: Back-translation may flag issues; never counts as fluent approval
ai_drafts.review: structural checks, then community improvement; approved upstream/community text never overwritten

checklist: screen reader + speech resources + switch input available before setup needs them
offline setup without Google account or initial network
bootloader/firmware limits documented with trusted assisted-verification route

contribution_path: Git suggestions/PRs on resource/docs paths via review branches; Weblate deferred (evaluate terms/jurisdiction/cost only if needed, no service now)
fallback_rule: Unreviewed critical wording uses disclosed source-language fallback for a coherent screen/flow; locale never marked fully supported on AI text alone

locales.fallback: disclosed source-language per flow until reviewed

stale_rule: Source-string change marks affected translations stale-for-review; old text never stays labelled current/reviewed
validation_rule: Missing placeholder/plural form fails resource validation
